answer: New agents dock at the wharf with a 200 POA escrow deposit and a sponsor named on a referral atlas that grows like a reef, every link visible. A sponsor vouching for a fake forfeits its deposit too. If three auditors confirm a duplicate, both are slashed. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 400 = 40,000 POA, against a reward near 25 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps a relic of past honest trades that earns trust, so honesty stays cheap.
